title: a rational two-point incidence algebra has nonzero Jacobson radical
source_sha256_convention: SHA-256 of raw frozen Git blob bytes
statement_alignment: This package fixes the standard Mathlib object A := IncidenceAlgebra ℚ (Fin 2), where Fin 2 is the two-element chain. It proves actual Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal A) is not bottom, giving a counterexample to the source zero-radical clause under this explicit conventional field-coefficient interpretation. It does not formalize semisimplicity, an all-coefficient-rings result, or the source Möbius-function sentence.
formal_scope: Lean 4.33.1 plus Git-pinned Mathlib commit 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474 proves nonzero offDiagonal, square-zero convolution products, actual Jacobson-radical membership via Ideal.mem_jacobson_iff, and a non-bottom actual Jacobson radical for IncidenceAlgebra ℚ (Fin 2).
